decisive_items: Positive for Chikungunya virus with weak viral load (detected by real-time PCR)
Positive IgM CHIKV serologic test (from initial diagnosis)
Stromal immune ring formation with underlying keratic precipitates
response.rationale: Vignette shows confirmed CHIKV infection (PCR and IgM) with anterior uveitis/keratitis features; R6 integrates viral etiology with uveitis presentation, more specific than R4 alone and more etiologic than R1/R3.

rejected.why: Describes immune corneal findings but lacks viral etiologic link; too generic.
Descriptive stromal keratitis without integrating laboratory-confirmed CHIKV infection.
Identifies CHIKV infection but does not capture the ocular inflammatory syndrome (uveitis/keratitis).
